title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Plant MagAttract v.2
author: Maja Todorovic

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix with the following volumes per sample:

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 mg of cryogenically homogenised tissue from each sample to 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes on dry ice to keep samples frozen.

steps.title: Homogenise Samples
steps.instruction: Add 374 µL of the lysis buffer master mix to each sample.

substeps.instruction: Homogenise sample and mastermix by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.

steps.title: Lyse Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes briefly to collect contents, then incubate on the heat block at 55 °C at 600 rpm for 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: Label nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates and fill the required wells as follows:

substeps.instruction: Sample plate: 15 µL Suspension G magnetic beads and 280 µL Buffer MB

steps.title: Transfer Lysate to Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Once lysis is complete, remove sample tubes from the heat block and centrifuge briefly to spin down.

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, transfer lysate from sample tubes to individual wells in the sample plate, avoiding large pieces of debris.

steps.title: Run KingFisher Protocol
steps.instruction: Select the required protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex and press the play button.

substeps.instruction: Load filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Remove the 'Tip Plate' when prompted by the instrument prior to loading the 'Sample Plate'.
Allow the protocol to run automatically (approximately 50 minutes).
Follow on-screen instructions to remove plates once the protocol is complete.

steps.title: Inspect and Clean Eluates
steps.instruction: Inspect elution plates for remaining magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: If beads are present (common in viscous samples), transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and place on a magnetic rack.
Allow approximately 5 minutes for beads to migrate.
Collect the clear DNA eluate using a wide-bore pipette tip.

steps.title: Collect and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Using a 200 µL multi-channel pipette and wide-bore tips, pipette eluates from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pipette mix with wide-bore tips to fully homogenise DNA in the eluate.
